```artifact
Feature: Services around Padmavathi Hospital

  Scenario: Patients register for appointments within the service zone
  Given Patients reside within a 25 sqkm radius of Padmavathi Hospital or specified PinCodes
  When Patients apply for an appointment
  Then Patients should be able to register for appointments

  Examples:
    | Patient Location | PinCode | Expected Result |
    | Within Zone     | 12345  | Success         |
    | Outside Zone    | 67890  | Failure         |

  Scenario: Chemist operations within the service zone
  Given Chemist operates within a 25 sqkm radius of Padmavathi Hospital or specified PinCodes
  When Chemist delivers medicines
  Then Chemist should deliver medicines

  Examples:
    | Chemist Location | PinCode | Expected Result |
    | Within Zone     | 12345  | Success         |
    | Outside Zone    | 67890  | Failure         |

  Scenario: Prescription routing to Chemist
  Given Patient's PinCode matches Chemist's PinCode
  When Prescription is sent
  Then Prescription should be routed to the correct Chemist

  Examples:
    | Patient PinCode | Chemist PinCode | Expected Result |
    | Matching PinCode | Matching PinCode | Success         |
    | Non-Matching PinCode | Matching PinCode | Failure         |

  Scenario: Chemist delivery and payment collection
  Given Chemist delivers medicines and collects payment
  When Chemist completes delivery
  Then Chemist should mark the Prescription

  Examples:
    | Chemist Location | PinCode | Expected Result |
    | Within Zone     | 12345  | Success         |
    | Outside Zone    | 67890  | Failure         |

  Scenario: Laboratory operations within the service zone
  Given Laboratory operates within a 25 sqkm radius of Padmavathi Hospital or specified PinCodes
  When Laboratory processes samples
  Then Laboratory should process samples

  Examples:
    | Laboratory Location | PinCode | Expected Result |
    | Within Zone     | 12345  | Success         |
    | Outside Zone    | 67890  | Failure         |
```
